title: Cook's membrane: tapered panel under end shear (plane stress)
description:
Cook's membrane (classic plane-stress benchmark; linear elastic, static). All quantities are in one consistent set of units (dimensionless).
Geometry: a tapered quadrilateral panel in the xy-plane with corners (0, 0), (48, 44), (48, 60) and (0, 44). The left edge x = 0 runs from (0, 0) to (0, 44); the right edge x = 48 runs from (48, 44) to (48, 60); the bottom and top edges are the straight lines joining (0, 0)-(48, 44) and (0, 44)-(48, 60). Thickness 1. The STEP file holds this panel in the plane z = 0.
Material: isotropic linear elastic, E = 1, Poisson's ratio 1/3; plane stress.
Supports: the left edge (x = 0) is fully clamped (both displacement components zero).
Load: a shear force of total magnitude 1 in the +y direction, uniformly distributed along the right edge (x = 48, length 16, i.e. 1/16 per unit length). The top and bottom edges are free.
Report: uy_C = vertical (y) displacement at point C = (48, 52), the midpoint of the loaded right edge.
